topics.title: AI agent observability just became its own security market
topics.why: CrowdStrike is buying Fiddler to bolt agent observability onto Falcon — enterprises now have to watch their agents the way they watch their network.

topics.title: The midterms just put AI and data-center buildout back on the table
topics.why: A Nov 16 policy brief says the 2026 midterm results could reshape federal AI and data-center rules right as power and permitting fights are heating up.

topics.title: AI-fluent grads still can't find a first job
topics.why: The New York Fed put recent-grad unemployment at 5.2% in Q3 even as employers keep saying they'd rather see AI skills than a diploma.

topics.title: OpenAI's new models are built for your job, not a benchmark
topics.why: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol reportedly target everyday professional work at lower compute cost — the opposite pitch from the usual frontier-capability race.

topics.title: 79% of companies have AI agents. 15% can prove they're worth it.
topics.why: A new Genpact report puts the clearest number yet on the gap between deploying agents and actually measuring what they return.
